extracted.intended_audience: PR professionals, communications teams, marketers, and journalists evaluating or pitching news stories
extracted.subtask_description: A PR-applied framework for judging whether a story or announcement is likely to attract media attention; intended to guide pitches and content creation. Focuses on seven classic news values to shape and localize stories for target audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeliness: The Power of "Now"
rubrics_metrics.description: Recent or current information; "news, by definition, is new information."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Connect announcements to trending topics and release information promptly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact: The Scope and Significance
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of people affected and depth of consequences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quantify the audience and illustrate broader implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proximity: The Local Connection
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographic or psychological closeness to audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Localize broader narratives for specific markets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prominence: The Power of Notable Names
rubrics_metrics.description: "Well-known individuals, brands, or institutions inherently generate more interest."

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty: The Allure of the Unusual
rubrics_metrics.description: Unique or unexpected elements capture attention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: First-to-market innovations, surprising data, unconventional approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflict: The Draw of Tension and Resolution
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame challenges as compelling stories with stakes and resolutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Interest: The Emotional Connection
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Testimonials showing how solutions affect real people.
